name: Nightborne Armaments' buff stays off above 35% health and steady below it (#7600)
contract: #7600: Nightborne Armaments 680789 reads 'While below 35% health, your damage taken is reduced by $680790s1%'. AscensionStarcaller Refresh (every 250 ms) adds the 680790 buff while the player is below 35% health and removes it otherwise, like the other module-driven buffs (100250, 801148, 706436). Their drivers' periodic triggers are turned into dummies and their buffs made permanent; 680789 kept its Spell.dbc PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL that casts 680790 every 250 ms regardless of health, and 680790 kept its 1 sec duration, so the buff flickered at full health and dropped every second below 35%. Expected: below 35% the buff is present with an unlimited duration, and at full health it is absent. The full-health flicker itself is not observable here: 680790 is DO_NOT_LOG, so its aura-triggered cast sends no SPELL_GO, and the trigger and the Refresh removal land in the same update.
